title: Aturan pemisahan yang ketat
blocks: p

Bab ini bertumpu pada satu aturan yang menentukan nilai Lexical Resource lebih banyak daripada kebiasaan lain mana pun: informal idiom tempatnya di Speaking, bukan di Writing Task 2. Expression yang sama yang memberi Anda nilai di interview bisa justru mengurangi nilai Anda di essay. Ini bukan sekadar soal selera gaya; ini aturan register, dan register justru yang diuji di band yang lebih tinggi.
p

Inilah alasan pemisahannya begitu tegas. IELTS Speaking menghargai bahasa yang alami dan spontan, jadi idiom yang dipakai di tempat yang tepat (it was a blessing in disguise, I was over the moon) menunjukkan bahwa Anda bisa memakai bahasa Inggris seperti penutur yang fasih. Sebaliknya, Writing Task 2 adalah formal academic essay.
p

Dalam konteks itu, idiom terasa santai, tidak serius, dan tidak pada tempatnya, dan menurunkan nada tulisan Anda ke arah Band 6, sehebat apa pun idiom-nya. Examiner tidak bertanya “apakah kandidat ini tahu idiom.” Examiner bertanya “apakah kandidat ini tahu di mana setiap jenis bahasa seharusnya dipakai.”
h2
Aturan untuk memutuskan
ul
**Aman untuk Task 2:** Apakah ini akan terdengar wajar di tajuk rencana koran atau artikel akademik? Jika ya, pakailah di essay Anda.
**Simpan untuk Speaking:** Apakah ini akan terdengar cocok dalam obrolan santai dengan teman? Jika ya, jangan pakai di Writing Task 2.
note

**Phrasal verb:** Banyak phrasal verb bersifat netral dan sama sekali tidak masalah dalam tulisan (carry out, bring about, result in). Yang informal dan bersifat idiom, yang harus dijauhkan dari Task 2, adalah get its act together, cough up, dan pull your socks up. Jika ragu, pilih satu verb formal saja (organise, pay, improve).

title: 50 idiom untuk Speaking (1–25)
blocks: tip
Pakailah idiom ini agar terdengar alami di interview. Label Part menunjukkan di bagian mana setiap idiom paling cocok. Jangan bawa satu pun ke essay Task 2.
h2
Part 1
ul
**once in a blue moon**: sangat jarang. Contoh: I eat out once in a blue moon.
**a piece of cake**: sangat mudah. Contoh: For me, cooking is a piece of cake.
**cost an arm and a leg**: sangat mahal. Contoh: Concert tickets cost an arm and a leg.
**a stone’s throw away**: sangat dekat. Contoh: My office is a stone’s throw away from home.
**a rip-off**: sesuatu yang harganya terlalu mahal. Contoh: That cafe is a total rip-off.
**hit it off**: langsung cocok atau akrab. Contoh: We hit it off the moment we met.
**call it a day**: berhenti bekerja untuk hari itu. Contoh: By six, I usually call it a day.
**get the hang of it**: mulai menguasai cara melakukan sesuatu. Contoh: It took me a week to get the hang of it.
**lend a hand**: membantu. Contoh: I often lend a hand at home.
**money doesn’t grow on trees**: uang itu terbatas, tidak mudah didapat. Contoh: My parents always said money doesn’t grow on trees.
**hit the books**: belajar dengan giat. Contoh: I need to hit the books this weekend.
h2
Part 2
ul
**over the moon**: sangat bahagia. Contoh: I was over the moon when I passed.
**on cloud nine**: bahagia sekali. Contoh: On my wedding day, I was on cloud nine.
**down in the dumps**: sedih atau murung. Contoh: I felt down in the dumps after the result.
**butterflies in my stomach**: rasa gugup bercampur gembira. Contoh: I had butterflies in my stomach before the interview.
**get cold feet**: tiba-tiba ragu atau gugup di saat terakhir. Contoh: I nearly got cold feet before the speech.
**a fish out of water**: merasa canggung di lingkungan baru. Contoh: On my first day abroad, I felt like a fish out of water.
**the last straw**: hal terakhir yang masih bisa ditoleransi. Contoh: The delay was the last straw.
**a blessing in disguise**: manfaat tersembunyi di balik sebuah kemunduran. Contoh: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
**the icing on the cake**: bonus tambahan yang menyenangkan. Contoh: The view was the icing on the cake.
**in at the deep end**: langsung dihadapkan pada hal sulit tanpa persiapan. Contoh: I was thrown in at the deep end on day one.
**burn the midnight oil**: bekerja atau belajar sampai larut malam. Contoh: Before finals, I burn the midnight oil.
h2
Part 3
ul
**go the extra mile**: berusaha lebih dari yang diharapkan. Contoh: Good teachers go the extra mile.
**pull your socks up**: meningkatkan usaha Anda. Contoh: I had to pull my socks up after the mock test.
**get the ball rolling**: memulai sesuatu. Contoh: Let me get the ball rolling on the project.

title: 50 idiom untuk Speaking (26–50)
blocks: h2
Part 3
ul
**get to grips with**: mulai memahami atau menguasai sesuatu. Contoh: It takes time to get to grips with a new city.
**a foot in the door**: kesempatan awal. Contoh: An internship gets your foot in the door.
**spread your wings**: menjadi mandiri dan mencoba hal-hal baru. Contoh: University lets young people spread their wings.
**keep up with the times**: mengikuti perkembangan zaman. Contoh: Businesses must keep up with the times.
**hit the nail on the head**: mengatakan sesuatu yang tepat sekali. Contoh: You’ve hit the nail on the head.
**see the bigger picture**: memahami situasi secara keseluruhan. Contoh: Leaders must see the bigger picture.
**think outside the box**: berpikir kreatif. Contoh: Innovation means thinking outside the box.
**keep an open mind**: tetap terbuka terhadap ide baru. Contoh: It helps to keep an open mind.
**sit on the fence**: tidak mau memihak. Contoh: On this issue, I refuse to sit on the fence.
**a mixed blessing**: sesuatu yang punya sisi baik dan sisi buruk. Contoh: Social media is a mixed blessing.
**the best of both worlds**: dua keuntungan sekaligus. Contoh: Remote work offers the best of both worlds.
**every cloud has a silver lining**: selalu ada hal baik di balik hal buruk. Contoh: Every cloud has a silver lining.
**on the same wavelength**: memiliki cara berpikir yang sama. Contoh: My colleague and I are on the same wavelength.
**in the same boat**: berada dalam situasi sulit yang sama. Contoh: During the crisis, we were all in the same boat.
**kill two birds with one stone**: menyelesaikan dua hal sekaligus. Contoh: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone.
**at the drop of a hat**: seketika, tanpa ragu. Contoh: She would travel at the drop of a hat.
**add fuel to the fire**: membuat situasi buruk menjadi lebih buruk. Contoh: His comment only added fuel to the fire.
**a needle in a haystack**: hampir mustahil ditemukan. Contoh: Finding a quiet flat there is like finding a needle in a haystack.
**pull strings**: memakai pengaruh atau koneksi untuk mendapatkan sesuatu. Contoh: He pulled strings to get the job.
**face the music**: menerima akibat dari perbuatan sendiri. Contoh: Sooner or later, you have to face the music.
**bite off more than you can chew**: mengambil tanggung jawab yang terlalu banyak. Contoh: I bit off more than I could chew last term.
h2
Part 2
ul
**learn something the hard way**: belajar sesuatu lewat pengalaman yang sulit. Contoh: I learned time management the hard way.
**in the middle of nowhere**: di tempat yang sangat terpencil. Contoh: The resort was in the middle of nowhere.
**a change of scenery**: suasana baru yang menyegarkan. Contoh: A holiday gives you a change of scenery.
**the trip of a lifetime**: perjalanan yang tak terlupakan seumur hidup. Contoh: Visiting the mountains was the trip of a lifetime.

title: 50 collocation untuk Writing (1–25)
blocks: tip
Pakailah collocation ini di Writing Task 2. Semuanya formal dan cocok untuk essay.
h2
Membuka dan membingkai topik
ul
**it is widely acknowledged that**: banyak orang menerima bahwa ini benar. Contoh: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
**there is no denying that**: tidak dapat disangkal bahwa. Contoh: There is no denying that technology has reshaped work.
**a growing body of evidence suggests that**: semakin banyak penelitian menunjukkan bahwa. Contoh: A growing body of evidence suggests that pollution harms cognition.
**it can be argued that**: dapat dikatakan secara masuk akal bahwa. Contoh: It can be argued that fees limit access.
**this essay will examine both views**: menandakan essay yang seimbang. Contoh: This essay will examine both views before offering an opinion.
**a widely held view**: pendapat yang umum. Contoh: A widely held view is that competition improves standards.
h2
Membangun argumen
ul
**it stands to reason that**: masuk akal bahwa. Contoh: It stands to reason that better roads reduce delays.
**a compelling argument**: argumen yang meyakinkan. Contoh: There is a compelling argument for renewable subsidies.
**a valid point**: klaim yang masuk akal. Contoh: Opponents make a valid point about cost.
**proponents argue that**: para pendukung menyatakan bahwa. Contoh: Proponents argue that automation raises productivity.
**critics contend that**: para penentang menegaskan bahwa. Contoh: Critics contend that it destroys jobs.
**it is worth noting that**: ada hal yang layak diperhatikan. Contoh: It is worth noting that results vary by region.
h2
Sebab dan akibat
ul
**play a pivotal role in**: sangat penting, berperan utama. Contoh: Education plays a pivotal role in development.
**give rise to**: menyebabkan. Contoh: Rapid growth gives rise to inequality.
**stem from**: berasal dari. Contoh: Many problems stem from poverty.
**be attributed to**: dapat dijelaskan oleh. Contoh: The decline can be attributed to weak demand.
**a contributing factor**: salah satu dari beberapa penyebab. Contoh: Poor diet is a contributing factor in obesity.
**have far-reaching consequences**: memiliki dampak yang luas. Contoh: Climate change has far-reaching consequences.
**as a direct result of**: disebabkan secara langsung oleh. Contoh: As a direct result of the ban, sales fell.
h2
Pertentangan dan concession
ul
**while it is true that**: mengakui suatu poin. Contoh: While it is true that costs are high, benefits outweigh them.
**contrary to popular belief**: berlawanan dengan pendapat umum. Contoh: Contrary to popular belief, remote work can raise output.
**despite the fact that**: memperkenalkan clause concession yang lengkap. Contoh: Despite the fact that it is costly, the plan is justified.
**on the one hand … on the other hand**: menimbang dua sisi. Contoh: On the one hand it saves time; on the other, it isolates people.
**to a certain extent**: sebagian. Contoh: This is true to a certain extent.
h2
Solusi dan evaluasi
ul
**address the issue**: menangani suatu masalah. Contoh: Governments must address the issue urgently.

title: 50 collocation untuk Writing (26–50)
blocks: h2
Solusi dan evaluasi
ul
**tackle the root cause**: menangani penyebab yang mendasarinya. Contoh: Lasting change means tackling the root cause.
**implement effective measures**: menerapkan kebijakan yang baik. Contoh: Cities should implement effective measures against pollution.
**a viable solution**: jawaban atau solusi yang bisa dijalankan. Contoh: Public transport is a viable solution to congestion.
**weigh the pros and cons**: mempertimbangkan kedua sisi. Contoh: Policymakers must weigh the pros and cons.
**strike a balance between**: mencari titik tengah yang adil. Contoh: We must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
**take into account**: mempertimbangkan. Contoh: Any policy must take into account rural needs.
h2
Tingkat, skala, dan waktu
ul
**a significant proportion of**: bagian yang cukup besar. Contoh: A significant proportion of graduates work abroad.
**the vast majority of**: hampir semua. Contoh: The vast majority of commuters use trains.
**in the long run**: dalam jangka panjang. Contoh: In the long run, prevention is cheaper.
**in the short term**: dalam waktu dekat, untuk sementara. Contoh: In the short term, costs may rise.
**an integral part of**: bagian yang sangat penting. Contoh: Art is an integral part of education.
**gain momentum**: semakin kuat. Contoh: The movement has gained momentum.
h2
Dampak dan trade-off
ul
**pose a serious threat to**: membahayakan. Contoh: Rising seas pose a serious threat to coasts.
**have a detrimental effect on**: merugikan. Contoh: Stress has a detrimental effect on health.
**reap the benefits of**: menikmati hasilnya. Contoh: Future generations will reap the benefits of this investment.
**at the expense of**: dengan mengorbankan hal lain. Contoh: Growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
h2
Contoh dan penekanan
ul
**a case in point**: contoh yang tepat. Contoh: Singapore is a case in point.
**to illustrate this**: untuk memberi contoh. Contoh: To illustrate this, consider public transport in Tokyo.
**bear in mind that**: mengingat. Contoh: We must bear in mind that resources are finite.
**shed light on**: menjelaskan, memperjelas. Contoh: The study sheds light on the causes.
**in light of**: mempertimbangkan, mengingat. Contoh: In light of these findings, reform is needed.
h2
Sikap dan kesimpulan
ul
**from my perspective**: menurut pendapat saya. Contoh: From my perspective, the benefits outweigh the risks.
**more often than not**: biasanya. Contoh: More often than not, early action is cheaper.
**by and large**: secara umum. Contoh: By and large, the policy has succeeded.
**draw a firm conclusion**: mencapai penilaian yang jelas. Contoh: It is difficult to draw a firm conclusion from limited data.

title: Practice · Memilah register dan memperbaiki idiom
blocks: exercise

blocks.title: Exercise 5.1 · Memilah Register dan Gaya
blocks.instructions: Setiap kalimat di bawah ini ditulis seolah-olah muncul dalam essay Writing Task 2. Tentukan apakah bagian yang digarisbawahi cocok untuk essay formal (tandai W) atau hanya cocok untuk Speaking (tandai S). Untuk setiap S, tulis ulang kalimatnya dalam bahasa Inggris akademik formal yang sesuai untuk Task 2.

items.prompt: Nowadays, a lot of kids are glued to their phones around the clock.
items.answer: S — These days, many children spend excessive time on their smartphones.
items.reason: A lot of kids, glued to, dan around the clock semuanya informal.

items.prompt: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
The government needs to get its act together on pollution.
items.answer: S — The government must take decisive action on pollution.
items.reason: Get its act together bersifat informal.

items.prompt: This policy could have far-reaching consequences.
At the end of the day, it is up to the individual.
items.answer: S — Ultimately, the responsibility lies with the individual.
items.reason: At the end of the day dan it is up to bersifat informal.

items.prompt: Renewable energy plays a pivotal role in cutting emissions.
Fast food is a rip-off and bad for you.
items.answer: S — Fast food is both overpriced and detrimental to health.
items.reason: A rip-off dan bad for you bersifat informal.

items.prompt: There is no denying that technology has transformed education.
Loads of people reckon that exams are unfair.
items.answer: S — A significant proportion of people believe that exams are unfair.
items.reason: Loads of dan reckon bersifat informal.

items.prompt: Poverty can be attributed to a range of social factors.
Young people these days could not care less about tradition.
items.answer: S — Many young people today show little interest in tradition.
items.reason: Could not care less bersifat informal.

items.prompt: Governments must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
Social media is a double-edged sword, to be honest.
items.answer: S — Social media brings both clear benefits and serious drawbacks.
items.reason: To be honest adalah hedge khas bahasa lisan.

items.prompt: This crisis stems from decades of underinvestment.
If you ask me, the whole system is a mess.
items.answer: S — In my view, the current system is deeply flawed.
items.reason: If you ask me dan a mess bersifat informal.

items.prompt: A growing body of evidence suggests a link between diet and disease.
Tourism can boost the economy, but it is a bit of a mixed bag.
items.answer: S — Tourism can boost the economy, though it brings mixed outcomes.
items.reason: A bit of a mixed bag bersifat informal.

items.prompt: In the long run, prevention is cheaper than treatment.
The rich should cough up more tax.
items.answer: S — The wealthy should contribute more in taxes.

items.prompt: It is worth noting that not all solutions are equally effective.

blocks: note

**Mengapa:** informal idiom dan phrasal verb menurunkan register essay Task 2, sehingga nilai Lexical Resource ikut turun meskipun vocabulary lainnya sudah kaya. Versi formal yang ditulis ulang tetap mempertahankan maknanya sekaligus mengembalikan nada akademik.
exercise

blocks.title: Exercise 5.2 · Substitusi Idiom
blocks.instructions: Setiap jawaban Speaking di bawah ini berisi idiom yang salah diingat, salah dipakai, atau keliru. Tulis ulang bagian yang digarisbawahi dengan bentuk yang benar dan alami. Ketik idiom yang benar.

items.prompt: When I got the scholarship, I was on cloud seven.
The final test was a piece of pie for me.
On my first day abroad, I felt like a fish in the water.
items.reason: Bukan “a fish in the water”; artinya merasa canggung di situasi baru.

items.prompt: My university is just a stone throw from my house.
Learning to drive was a really steep hill at first.
We managed to kill two birds in one stone by cycling to work.
items.answer: kill two birds with one stone

items.prompt: After the experiment failed, it was back to the painting board.
Honestly, I would travel at the drop of the hat.
items.answer: at the drop of a hat
